```{r}
#| label: pillar-component
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# The research-pillar component (R/pillar_cards.R), rendered to static HTML at
# build time from data/generated/ and data/pillar-copy.yml, so that it is
# complete without JavaScript. Included by research/index.qmd and index.qmd;
# each of them also loads js/pillars.js, which enhances the markup. The block
# is the chunk's value (knitr::asis_output), so non-ASCII text stays UTF-8 in
# any locale.
local({
  root <- Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR")
  if (!nzchar(root)) stop("Render this page with Quarto from the project (QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR is not set).")
  source(file.path(root, "R", "config.R"), local = TRUE)
  source(file.path(root, "R", "pillar_cards.R"), local = TRUE)
  knitr::asis_output(pillar_component_block(root))
})
```
